answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on the WMT data-sets , including WMT17 Chinese to English CWMT part (Zh→En), WMT 14 English to German (En→De) and English to Romanian (En→Ro) machine translation tasks.

answer_2.quote: We use the sacreBLEU to calculate case-sensitive BLEU as the automatic metric.

answer_4.quote: We invite a professional translator to label errors contained in these translations.
answer_4.guideline: We divide mistranslations into several types and each type has three degrees.
